scope_notes: ThemeTokens computes a stable sha256-v1 version from the immutable, normalized, ordered token map; render rejects a manifest whose version does not match the token contents.

CSS rejection identifies actual case-insensitive url( and expression( function tokens. The restricted character grammar excludes escaping, comments, strings, declaration separators, schemes, and CSS attribute breakout; burlywood and URL (red) remain accepted.

The reproducible 10000-case corpus creates variable-length fragment sequences from 32 HTML and 32 CSS fragments; it varies ordering and marker placement and asserts uniqueness, structural diversity, and fragment/length/position coverage.
